name: Sportking India Limited
summary: Sportking India Limited manufactures, purchases, and sells textile yarns in India and internationally. It offers cotton, polyester/cotton blended, fancy, dyed, grey, and acrylic and acrylic/polyester blended yarns, as well as knitted fabrics. The company also engages in the yarns and fibers dyeing and processing business. In addition, it produces T-shirts, shirts, sweatshirts, sweaters, jackets, jeans, trousers, track pants, tracksuits, Bermuda and shorts, and nightwear for boys and men; and tops, tunics, shirts, kurtis, sweatshirts, sweaters, cardigans, jeans, trousers, leggings, track pants, tracksuits, shorts, nightwear, and lingerie for girls and ladies.
